incidents.summary: Smith Law Firm sued ICG Investments and two other investment firms, alleging they fraudulently induced it to enter two loan agreements for talcum powder litigation.

sources.title: Talcum Law Firm Accuses Litigation Funders of ‘Pirating’ Cases
sources.quote: A Mississippi-based plaintiffs’ firm accused three large investment firms of fraudulently inducing it to enter into two loan agreements on false grounds for talcum powder litigation.

sources.title: Talcum Law Firm Accuses Litigation Funders of ‘Pirating’ Cases
sources.quote: The Smith Law Firm filed suit Wednesday against Ellington Financial, ICG Investments, and Stifel Financial
